subject_identity_preserved.rationale: A single adult African elephant remains the central subject across the sequence. Some tusk length, body scale, and skin tone vary between distant, close-up, and frontal views, but the subject does not clearly change into a different animal.

background_coherent.rationale: The savanna setting, acacia trees, golden grass, distant hills, daylight, and safari-vehicle framing persist. Close-up shots introduce greener foliage, but it remains plausible within the same safari environment.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the inside-vehicle savanna view with elephant, windshield bars, acacia trees, grass, and hills.
Matches the filmmaker, professional camera rig, vehicle interior, distant elephant, and savanna background.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence includes legitimate variation: wide vehicle views, filmmaker insert, repeated savanna view, close-ups, full-body approach, and passenger reaction. Shot 0 and shot 2 are somewhat visually redundant, but the sequence does not collapse overall.

motion_continuity.rationale: The elephant plausibly progresses from distant side views to closer frontal views and continues advancing near the vehicle. Some cuts are abrupt, especially into the close-up, but the sampled frames show meaningful position, framing, and action changes.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 2's medium-wide distant elephant to shot 3's extreme close-up is the largest spatial jump and slightly weakens continuity, though it is still plausible as a new camera framing.

cheat_flags.rationale: There is no copied-frame or frozen-sequence behavior. Shot 0 and shot 2 are similar, but later shots add clear camera, subject-distance, and human-observer variation.
